in_sanskrit.name: जग्वीर

in_marathi.name: Jagveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jagveer is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jagat' meaning 'world' and 'veer' meaning 'hero' or 'victorious'. This name signifies a brave and invincible individual, who is victorious over the world.
